payload.text: Rules in force for dc: every host run, however small (one bats file, one prez AT), is booked by name with the booker vc names (gtools-vc on 18 Oct: a START, its GO, an END, by SendMessage), nothing heavy runs without a GO, and reading needs no window. CI's shellcheck is 0.9.0, which flags A && B || C as SC2015 where 0.11.0 passes: run it under 0.9.0 (on kovacs, or its darwin build here under Rosetta) before handing on, with a control whose B and C are not echo. A portable stat puts GNU stat -c first. No Hammerspoon, pointer, xcodebuild or hv's real keychain from dc; nothing pushed by dc.
